title: Adapter session on resident CUDA/Metal prefills prompt with base weights
reason: Batched-prefill admission never checked the bound LoRA adapter, running adapter prompts as the base default; fix adds a !hasAdapter decline at residentPrefillSeed.
option_or_family: LoRA adapter (--adapter) bound to a resident session

title: Resident prefix reuse ignores which adapter built the cached KV
reason: Reuse predicate matched token ids only; the adapter that built the KV was unaccounted for and treated as base; fix records it and declines on mismatch.
option_or_family: adapter identity of the resident KV prefix

title: Bailing Hybrid KDA state unknown to Recurrent bit and hasRecurrentState
reason: A new recurrent state kind (KDA) missing from the registry bit, hasRecurrentState and resetRecurrent; reuse, reset and rollback treat it as non-recurrent default.
option_or_family: KDA recurrent state (bailing_hybrid)

title: Cohere resident on CUDA uses RMSNorm tail; batched prefill ignores layerNorm
reason: CUDA tails hard-code RMS and prefillStaticDecline omits layerNorm/parallelBlock, so the Cohere family runs as the default RMS path; fix adds dispatch and decline.
option_or_family: Cohere/Command-R (layerNorm, parallelBlock, logit_scale)
path_missed: CUDA decode/prefill tail norm dispatch, prefillStaticDecline, prefill-tail logit scale

title: Dense Granite GGUF q/k rows loaded without RoPE un-permute
reason: ggufQKPermuted name list lacked "granite", so its permuted q/k were loaded as the default unpermuted case; fix adds the family to the list.
option_or_family: granite (dense Granite 4.2 GGUF)

title: gpt-oss int4 WebGPU dispatches int8 down-projection kernel on int4 experts
reason: moeExpertGptOssDown had no s.w4 branch, so the int4 quant was dispatched as the int8 default; fix branches on w4 or declines.
option_or_family: int4 quant (W4A8 stacked experts) for gpt-oss on WebGPU

title: Metal executor commits buffer pre-encoded under previous adapter state
reason: SetAdapter lifecycle never invalidated the executor's pre-encoded command buffer, so stale state ran; R (state x lifecycle path) over O (ordering hazard), but close.
option_or_family: pre-encoded Metal executor command buffer across adapter changes

title: Metal batched prefill on paged MoE binds zero-value expert buffers
reason: prefillOK admission checks features and geometry but never MoE paging, so --moe-cache-slots models take batched prefill; fix adds one predicate term.
option_or_family: paged generic MoE (--moe-cache-slots / MoE slot env vars)

title: WebGPU int8-KV m-RoPE writes K scale at rope position
reason: The i8 rope-store path handles m-RoPE but indexes the scale write by rope position instead of true position: an indexing error, not a missed registration.

title: Parity manifest aikit_version stale; staleness gate disarmed again
reason: The parity staleness gate hashes a hand-typed aikit_version that drifted from go.mod, so it stays green across aikit bumps.

title: olmo_hybrid validated with deps_hash covering zero source files
reason: A validated family's deps_hash covers no files, so the parity freshness gate can never restale it; the defect is in the gate's manifest.

title: Seven v0.17.0 families' parity gates cannot block a tag
reason: CI skips gitignored fixtures, the sweep files FAILs as FIRST-RUN and the ledger is unpromoted, so the parity gates cannot block anything.

title: deps_hash refreshed by hand bypassing red-golden refusal; -update unguarded
reason: The refresh refusal is bypassable and -update has none, so deps_hash is refreshed while required goldens are red; evidence-chain gate defect.

title: Recurrent-bit and spec-rollback tests use hand-written family lists
reason: The tests compare the registry bit against hand-written family lists, so a family missing from both passes; incomplete hand list, r-shaped.

title: Resident-LoRA gates cannot see C-01 or C-07
reason: The gates drive per-token Forward, never PrefillLast, use a 3-token fake prompt, and bind Metal on a fresh executor, so they cannot fail.

title: gpt-oss WebGPU parity gate blind to dropped expert-down term
reason: A bias-dominated fixture and 0.95 cosine floor sit below the damage of a dropped expert matmul term, so the gate cannot fail on C-06.

title: Metal prefill gate narrows decision set silently; decline SKIP still ships
reason: The decision gate drops missing-reference cells and turns a build decline into SKIP yet prints SHIPS; only the first half reproduced.

title: PTX freshness lacks a device-free check; absence counts as skip
reason: The only PTX freshness check is NVRTC-patch-bound and its absence is a counted skip on a PASS; CI has no step.

title: webgpu-parity cell selects only ResidentParity; seven tests ungated
reason: The webgpu-parity cell's selector reaches only ResidentParity, so seven gate-shaped WebGPU tests run in no gate cell or CI runner.

title: FMA lint misses reversed multiply-add; one ships in a linted kernel
reason: The lint regex misses c + a*b, so a bare float MAC ships in a linted kernel; filed against the lint, not the kernel.

title: serve check tools and stop rows certify what they don't read
reason: The doctor's tools row passes turn two on any 200 and the stop row passes when the stop never fires; checks don't check their claim.

title: Smaller instances of tests and checks that cannot fail
reason: All eleven are vacuous tests/checks. Dominant (b) hand-lists 15/22 kernel modules; (c) hand-counts GGUF family cases (r-shaped); rest are stale claims, vacuous skips, grep checks.

title: Adapter or reused-image VL prompt past resident cap dies with 500
reason: The cap guard's residentPath keyed adapters (and VL) as staged, so resident routes skipped ResidentContextCap; R (route unregistered) vs B (cap unchecked) nearly equal.
option_or_family: LoRA adapter route and reused-image VL route running resident
path_missed: prepare residentPath predicate (lm.adapter == "") / P9a full-reuse branch

title: VL resident clamp sites never publish BudgetClamped; finish_reason reads stop
reason: VL paths clamp to the cap but never publish BudgetClamped, so effectiveBudget treats them as the unclamped default; R vs O (missing field set) close.
option_or_family: resident-cap budget clamp on the seven VL paths
path_missed: VL clamp sites' Budget/BudgetClamped publication read by effectiveBudget

title: n-gram and draft spec loops refused at resident cap, not finished
reason: Draft width is not clamped to the resident context cap before ForwardN, so a reachable round exceeds it and errors; the fix is a clamp.
option_or_family: resident context cap (ResidentContextCap)
path_missed: n-gram and draft-model spec loops' draft width

title: .giw bundles lose generation_config.json EOS ids
reason: The .giw serializer and loader branch ignore generation_config's resolved EOS set, falling back to config.json's default; R vs N (wrong propagation) somewhat close.
option_or_family: generation_config.json extra EOS ids (resolved EOS set)

title: LoRA delta In/Out never checked against base projection shape
reason: A delta's In/Out can exceed the base projection's buffers with no check, giving OOB reads/writes or panics; fix is a load-time bound refusal. B over O.
option_or_family: base projection In/Out dimensions vs adapter delta shape
path_missed: validateTargets / LoadAdapter / applyLoRA (names only, no shape check)

title: GenerateVL imgHash==0 documented as never matching but matches
reason: The reuse predicate lacks the zero-hash 'no claim' case, treating 0 as an ordinary hash; product-code defect, so R before G (doc mismatch).
option_or_family: imgHash == 0 'no claim' sentinel

title: GenerateGemma4VL commits resIDs without an image-block record
reason: The Gemma 4 VL commit omits the image-block record its siblings register, so the reuse scan treats image positions as plain text.
option_or_family: Gemma 4 VL image block

title: Model.Plan reports resident for families the runtime declines
reason: Plan omits ResidentEligible's checks, so ineligible families and unrecognised backends fall through to the default 'resident' verdict.
option_or_family: families/backends ResidentEligible declines (Llama-4/cuda, Gemma 4/webgpu, Kimi-K2/metal, unknown backend)

title: Staged WebGPU int4 decode, prefill and verify use different kernels
reason: Spec admission did not know staged webgpu int4 splits decode and verify kernels, breaking verify==decode; R vs G (false bit-identity comment) close.
option_or_family: staged WebGPU int4/int4mix

title: CUDA resident HiddenLast breaks bit-identity contract above 512 tokens
reason: The fast-lever gate didn't know the HiddenLast tail needs exact kernels, so long prompts took the non-bit-identical path; R vs G (no gate).
option_or_family: tailHiddenLast prefill tail (/v1/embeddings)

title: CUDA spec verify exact only by M<16 coincidence
reason: The fast-lever dispatch has no exact-only case for verify tails; exactness relied on M<16. R over B: 16 is a perf floor, not a capacity.
option_or_family: spec-verify tails (tailAllLogits/tailAllArgmax)

title: Fit-by-default interior ctx always fails checkKVFits; falls to CPU
reason: The planner's sizing arithmetic omits checkKVFits' margin, so interior ctx choices always fail the build; the build check exists, so not B; N vs O(perf).

title: Non-streaming responses have no write deadline while decode mutex held
reason: A missing write deadline lets a stalled client pin the worker and decode mutex: a hang/resource issue, not registration, bound or numerics.

title: --fit=off rejected by the parser; goinfer-chat lacks --fit
reason: Server message and task doc promise --fit=off, which the bool parser rejects: the rubric's flag-value claim example; chat lacking --fit is secondary.

title: Pre-tokenize guard ignores tool schemas and tool_call arguments
reason: The size guard omits rendered tool fields, treating them as zero bytes; R (fields unregistered) vs B (byte budget exceeded) nearly equal; R tested first.
option_or_family: tools schemas and replayed tool_calls arguments

title: /v1/responses silently drops tools on non-tool templates
reason: /v1/responses lacked the named 400 decline its siblings have, silently treating tools as the absent default; R vs O (request validation).
option_or_family: tools on a template with no tool form

title: Resident HiddenLast unreachable from serve; embedder loaded with empty Options
reason: The embedder loader ignores --backend and -embed-quant, loading with default Options so resident HiddenLast never runs; R vs O (missing wiring).
option_or_family: --backend and -embed-quant for the decoder embedder

title: CUDA vision tower leaks device scratch and streams per image
reason: Dominant defect is a per-image device-scratch and stream leak; the cuda-not-enabled wiring (R-shaped) and stale DONE doc are secondary.

title: fit reads free RAM after loading the model it plans
reason: The free-RAM budget is measured after the model loads, so the CPU fit is priced against a consumed budget: sizing error, not a missing check.

title: fit -measure double-loads the checkpoint and counts prefill in rate
reason: The rate formula folds prefill into tok/s (N); the double-load overlap is O resource lifetime; N tested first, halves comparable.
